import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source_0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_36/training_0.csv"
source_1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_36/training_1.csv"
source_2_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_36/training_2.csv"

df_0 = pd.read_csv(source_0_path, index_col=0)
df_1 = pd.read_csv(source_1_path, index_col=0)
df_2 = pd.read_csv(source_2_path, index_col=0)

# Operation History:
# 1) JOIN : [["Source3_36_1", "Source3_36_2"], ["County", "County"]]
# Join Source1 and Source2 on 'County'
df_1_2 = pd.merge(df_1, df_2, on="County", how="inner")

# 2) JOIN : [["Source3_36_0", "Source3_36_1"], ["County", "County"]]
# Join Source0 and the result of previous join (df_1_2) on 'County'
df_final = pd.merge(df_0, df_1_2, on="County", how="inner")

# According to target schema: ['County': string, 'm1401': string, 'm1403': string]
# We only keep columns County, m1401, m1403
# m1401 and m1403 come from df_1 and df_2 respectively
df_target = df_final[["County", "m1401", "m1403"]].copy()

# Ensure all columns are string type as per target schema
df_target["County"] = df_target["County"].astype(str)
df_target["m1401"] = df_target["m1401"].astype(str)
df_target["m1403"] = df_target["m1403"].astype(str)

# Write the result to the specified path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_36/target_multisource.csv"
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore numerical index column
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_36/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_36/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
source3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_36/training_3.csv", index_col=0)

# Join Source3_36_1 and Source3_36_2 on County
join_1_2 = pd.merge(source1, source2, on="County", how="inner")

# Join the above result with Source3_36_3 on County to filter to counties present in Source3_36_3
final_join = pd.merge(join_1_2, source3, on="County", how="inner")

# Group by ['County', 'm1401'] to ensure uniqueness as per target keys
final = final_join.groupby(["County", "m1401"], as_index=False).first()

# Select only the target columns in order
final = final[["County", "m1401", "m1403"]]

# Write to output CSV
final.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_36/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
